# Model catalogue

Everything the model registries contain, generated from the code. PyGeoVision has **three** lists of models that serve different purposes ([how they relate](registry.md)); this page shows each.

| List | Entries | What it is | Browse with |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Native registry](#native-registry) | 79 | Architectures you can build with `get_model` | `pygeovision models list` |
| [Legacy engine registry](#legacy-engine-registry) | 14 | The names the `infer`, `ai` and `channel` commands load your checkpoint into | `pygeovision ai-models list` |
| [Model zoo](#model-zoo) | 96 | A descriptive catalogue; nothing is built from it | `pygeovision zoo list` |

(native-registry)=
## Native registry

Names use hyphens (`unet-r50`, `segformer-b2`). Build one with `get_model(name, num_classes=, in_channels=, pretrained=)`. The **Build** column says what to expect:

| Build | Meaning |
|---|---|
| builds | Constructs with no network. `pretrained=True` additionally downloads weights |
| wrapper | Returns a helper object that loads its weights on first use |
| pretrained only | Cannot be built without its pretrained weights |
| needs Hub / needs torchgeo | Needs a network connection or an extra package even for an untrained model |
| embeddings | A precomputed data product, not a trainable network |
| listed only | Visible for discovery; `get_model` raises `NotImplementedError` and says why |

**Parameters (M)** are the published size of the architecture, not a measurement of the object built here (sizes change with your band and class counts).

(legacy-engine-registry)=
## Legacy engine registry

These 14 names are what `--model` accepts in `pygeovision infer ...`, `pygeovision ai infer|detect|segment`, `pygeovision channel ... --checkpoint` and YAML `infer` steps. Names use underscores. A name that is not here falls through to the native registry, so `--model unet-r50` also works.

| Name | Task | Architecture | Bands | Pretrained weights | Description |
|---|---|---|---:|---|---|
| `changeformer` | change_detection | ChangeFormer | 3 | no | Two SegFormer networks (one per date) fused by a 1x1 convolution; randomly initialised, no pretrained weights. Not the published ChangeFormer. |
| `siamese_unet` | change_detection | Siamese-UNet | 3 | no | Siamese U-Net for bi-temporal change detection. |
| `efficientnet_b3_cls` | classification | EfficientNet-B3 | 3 | yes | EfficientNet-B3 scene classifier — compact and accurate. |
| `resnet50_cls` | classification | ResNet-50 | 3 | yes | ResNet-50 scene classifier. |
| `vit_b16_cls` | classification | ViT-B/16 | 3 | yes | Vision Transformer (ViT-B/16) scene classifier. |
| `fcos_resnet50` | detection | FCOS | 3 | yes | FCOS anchor-free object detector with ResNet-50 backbone. |
| `retinanet_resnet50` | detection | RetinaNet | 3 | yes | RetinaNet with focal loss for dense small object detection. |
| `deeplabv3plus_resnet101` | segmentation | DeepLabV3+ | 3 | yes | DeepLabV3+ with ResNet-101 — strong baseline for land cover mapping. |
| `segformer_b2` | segmentation | SegFormer | 3 | yes | SegFormer-B2 transformer segmentation model. |
| `segformer_b5` | segmentation | SegFormer | 3 | yes | SegFormer-B5 — largest SegFormer variant, highest accuracy. |
| `unet_efficientnet_b4` | segmentation | UNet | 3 | yes | U-Net with EfficientNet-B4 encoder. Better accuracy at similar speed. |
| `unet_resnet50` | segmentation | UNet | 3 | yes | U-Net with ResNet-50 encoder. Workhorse for pixel-wise segmentation. |
| `esrgan_geo` | super_resolution | ESRGAN-Geo | any | no | ESRGAN adapted for satellite imagery super-resolution. |
| `srcnn` | super_resolution | SRCNN | any | no | Super-Resolution CNN (SRCNN) — lightweight baseline. |

**Bands** is the default input band count; every model is built for the band count you pass.

(model-zoo)=
## Model zoo

The zoo describes 96 architectures (parameter counts, tags, typical uses). It is a *catalogue*: `pygeovision zoo ...` helps you read about models, and nothing in the zoo builds a model. Only 18 entries name a Hugging Face checkpoint. To build a model, take the name from the native or legacy registry.

| Task | Entries |
|---|---:|
| 3d | 6 |
| change_detection | 10 |
| classification | 19 |
| detection | 17 |
| foundation | 10 |
| segmentation | 17 |
| super_resolution | 4 |
| timeseries | 6 |
| vlm | 7 |
